CLI and bundled gateway advance together to 0.16.33 and protocol 93.

The CLI renders the unified action-list widgets and failed item state, follows middleware-owned voice and attachment settings, and preserves editable forms after gateway rejection. Reference matching retains only the visible results, and URL editors keep a bounded input buffer.

The bundled gateway includes standalone voice middleware, computer-control lifecycle fixes, Anthropic thinking handling and DeepSeek Flash image input. Back up and convert existing state offline before upgrading to config 29, Bot state 9 and checkpoint 20. Older clients cannot connect to the new gateway.
